final: WITH f AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, t.UnitPrice AS price, CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds AS bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804), g AS (SELECT name, AVG(price) AS avg_price, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM f GROUP BY name), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.name, g.avg_price, g.avg_bpm, g.avg_bpm / o.overall AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL
